note: Older city-run RV park at the Calistoga Fairgrounds, a short walk from downtown. Deluxe sites have full hookups; regular sites have 30-amp power and water, with a sewer clean-out by the restrooms. No tent camping outside large approved events. The Vine shuttle runs into town. --Claude
